Fields.Name: Attack ID
Fields.Description: The attack this shot deals when it hits someone. It sets the damage, stamina drain and knockback. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Particle ID: Projectile
Fields.Description: How the shot looks and sounds while it flies. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Particle ID: Impact
Fields.Description: The flash and sound when the shot hits something or ends. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Particle ID: Repel
Fields.Description: The flash and sound when the shot is blocked or knocked away. -1 means None. The exact trigger is not established.

Fields.Name: Duration (seconds)
Fields.Description: How long the shot lasts before it vanishes. -1 means it never expires on its own.

Fields.Name: Attenuation Range (metres)
Fields.Description: How far the shot flies before it starts to weaken. Past this point the out-of-range flight values apply and it deals no stamina damage. It can still fly further.

Fields.Name: Shoot Interval (seconds)
Fields.Description: How often the shot fires again while its attack lasts. 0 fires only once.

Fields.Name: Gravity: In Range (m/s^2)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot drops while inside its range. Negative values make it climb instead.

Fields.Name: Gravity: Out of Range (m/s^2)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot drops after passing its range. Negative values make it climb instead.

Fields.Name: Homing Stop Range (metres)
Fields.Description: How close to its target the shot gets before it stops homing. Past this point it flies straight.

Fields.Name: Initial Velocity (m/s)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot moves when fired.

Fields.Name: Acceleration: In Range (m/s^2)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot speeds up while inside its range. Negative values slow it down.

Fields.Name: Acceleration: Out of Range (m/s^2)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot speeds up after passing its range. Negative values slow it down.

Fields.Name: Maximum Velocity (m/s)
Fields.Description: The fastest the shot can move. Acceleration never pushes it past this.

Fields.Name: Minimum Velocity (m/s)
Fields.Description: The slowest the shot can move. Slowing never drops it below this.

Fields.Name: Acceleration Start Delay (seconds)
Fields.Description: How long after firing before acceleration starts. 0 accelerates at once.

Fields.Name: Homing Start Distance (metres)
Fields.Description: How far the shot flies before it starts homing. 0 homes at once.

Fields.Name: Hit Radius: Initial (metres)
Fields.Description: How wide the shot is for hitting targets. Wider shots connect more easily.

Fields.Name: Hit Radius: Maximum (metres)
Fields.Description: How wide the shot grows to over time. -1 keeps the starting size.

Fields.Name: Hit Radius: Spread Time (seconds)
Fields.Description: How long the shot takes to grow to its full size. Below 0.2 only the starting size is used.

Fields.Name: Hit Radius: Expansion Delay (seconds)
Fields.Description: Unknown. From's notes describe a delay after landing, but no used row shows what it does.

Fields.Name: Homing Correction Offset (metres)
Fields.Description: How far ahead of a moving target the shot aims. 0 aims straight at the target.

Fields.Name: Damage Application Interval (seconds)
Fields.Description: How often a piercing shot can hit the same target again. 0 means it hits only once.

Fields.Name: External Force Modifier
Fields.Description: Extra push along the shot's path. Its exact strength is not established.

Fields.Name: Shooter SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: An effect placed on whoever fires the shot. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Funnel Think ID
Fields.Description: Controls orbiting shots like Homing Soulmass, such as when they launch. Its exact details are not established.

Fields.Name: Hit Bullet ID
Fields.Description: A second shot fired when this one ends, used for explosions. -1 means None. When it fires depends on Launch Condition Type.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID: 0
Fields.Description: An effect placed on whoever the shot hits, such as poison. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID: 1
Fields.Description: An effect placed on whoever the shot hits, such as poison. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID: 2
Fields.Description: An effect placed on whoever the shot hits, such as poison. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID: 3
Fields.Description: An effect placed on whoever the shot hits, such as poison. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID: 4
Fields.Description: An effect placed on whoever the shot hits, such as poison. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Number of Shots
Fields.Description: How many shots fire each time. Spacing comes from the firing angle intervals.

Fields.Name: Homing Strength (degrees/second)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot turns toward its target. Higher values track harder.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Firing Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: Sideways aim of the shot. 0 fires straight ahead.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Firing Angle Interval (degrees)
Fields.Description: Sideways spread between shots when firing several at once.

Fields.Name: Vertical Firing Angle Interval (degrees)
Fields.Description: Upward or downward spread between shots when firing several at once. Positive angles up, negative angles down.

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff: Physical (%/s)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot loses physical damage after passing its range. Higher values drain it faster. 0 keeps full damage.

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff: Magic (%/s)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot loses magic damage after passing its range. Higher values drain it faster. 0 keeps full damage.

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff: Fire (%/s)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot loses fire damage after passing its range. Higher values drain it faster. 0 keeps full damage.

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff: Lightning (%/s)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot loses lightning damage after passing its range. Higher values drain it faster. 0 keeps full damage.

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff: Stamina (%/s)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot loses stamina damage after passing its range. Higher values drain it faster. 0 keeps full damage.

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff: Knockback (%/s)
Fields.Description: How fast the shot loses knockback after passing its range. Higher values drain it faster. 0 keeps full knockback.

Fields.Name: Vertical Firing Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: Upward or downward aim of the shot. Positive angles up, negative angles down. 0 fires level.

Fields.Name: Maximum Tracking Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: How far off a locked-on target the aim can be before the shot stops turning toward it.

Fields.Name: Penetrate Map
Fields.Description: Lets the shot pass through characters and objects instead of stopping. It may hit the same target again once the damage interval passes.

Fields.Name: Previous Movement Direction Addition %
Fields.Description: Unknown. From's notes link it to sliding shots off walls, but this is not established.

Fields.Name: Attack Attribute
Fields.Description: What kind of physical blow the shot counts as, such as slash or thrust. Armor resists each kind separately.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute
Fields.Description: The shot's element, used for its look and the death animation it causes. Its damage still comes from the attack.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation Type
Fields.Description: May change the hit flash and sound. Its exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation: Material
Fields.Description: May change the hit flash and sound. Its exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation: Size
Fields.Description: Unknown. It is never used.

Fields.Name: Launch Condition Type
Fields.Description: When the extra shot from Hit Bullet ID appears. Always fires it when this shot ends or hits something.

Fields.Name: Follow Type
Fields.Description: How the shot moves. Do not follow flies straight. The rest track the owner, the victim, or the ground.

Fields.Name: Emitter Position Type
Fields.Description: Where the shot appears when fired. Higher values scatter shots around the caster or the target. The details are not established.

Fields.Name: Persistent Hit Particles
Fields.Description: Leaves the shot stuck in whoever it hits, like an arrow.

Fields.Name: Allow Continuous Hit
Fields.Description: Unknown. Only a few rows use it.

Fields.Name: Penetrate Map
Fields.Description: Lets the shot fly through walls and floors.

Fields.Name: Hit Both Teams
Fields.Description: Lets the shot hit the shooter's allies too.

Fields.Name: Use Shared Hit List
Fields.Description: Makes several shots from one firing share one damage timer on a target. Its exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Use Multiple Dummy Polygons for Emit
Fields.Description: Unknown. It is never used.

Fields.Name: Deflection Type
Fields.Description: Lets this shot knock other shots out of the air, like Force. 1 stops physical shots and 3 stops dark shots.

Fields.Name: Is Physical Projectile (for Deflection)
Fields.Description: Lets this shot be knocked away by shots like Force. Those use Deflection Type 1.

Fields.Name: Block Hit Particle Emit on Water Collision
Fields.Description: Skips the hit flash and sound when the shot lands in water. No used row proves it works.

Fields.Name: Penetrate Water Collision
Fields.Description: Lets the shot fly through water instead of stopping.

Fields.Name: Is Magical Projectile (for Deflection)
Fields.Description: Lets this shot be knocked away by dark-deflecting shots. Those use Deflection Type 3.
